title: Secret Bases
description: A Small Secret Base Mod, adding walk-through blocks and a few more usefull blocks to hide your base.
body:
This mod adds a few things like;

~Walk-through blocks that are textured like some in-game blocks
~Solid Lava (Why not use this to make a secret base in the middle of a nether lava-lake!)
~Non-burn lava (This could also help with the above!)
~Solid water (Perfect for a trap!)
~Ghosts, drop phantome membranes, put these with stone for example and out comes walkthrough stone!
~Liquid sand, so you can swim into the ocean and swim through the floor! (Into your secret base!)
~A HOLLOW OAK LOG! You can climb up inside AND you can place it facing different directions!
~Its own creative tab!


Heres a list of all the blocks you can craft with Phantom membranes to make the block(s) walk-through

~Stone
~Deepslate
~Dirt
~Grass block
~Sand
~Netherrack
~Endstone
~Ice
~Oak log


Heres the crafting Recipes for the other stuff;

Fill the left and right collums of the crafting table with oak logs for the hollow oak log.

Combine a water bucket and phantom membrane for solid water.

Combine a lava bucket and phantom membrane for nonburn lava.

Combine lava and water buckets for solid lava.

Combine a water bucket with sand for liquid sand.


                     Have Fun


                                     BlackWolfModding
